### The Unraveling of a Legacy
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-october-31-2019.html
Passage: 1 Kings 11:4
Points:
- Spiritual unraveling happens gradually through small compromises rather than sudden collapse.
- Despite starting well with God-given wisdom, Solomon failed to guard his heart.
- Clinging to forbidden relationships enticed his affections away from the Lord.
- While David owned his sin and repented, Solomon persisted in disobedience.
- God desires our wholehearted love, not merely outward achievements or religious motions.

### Defiance: A Biblical Warning
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/article/defiance-a-biblical-warning
Passage: 1 Kings 11:1-2
Points:
- Rebellion rarely emerges out of nowhere; it grows out of earlier seeds of compromise.
- Solomon openly defied Scripture by pursuing and clinging to foreign wives.
- Resisting accountability and godly counsel fostered dangerous, unchecked independence.
- Persisting in willful defiance ultimately turned Solomon's heart away from spiritual matters.
